title: Generated DWG HEADER excluded-high-size profiles and diagnostic control
scope: Correct generated AC1027/AC1032 HEADER controls to model the writer's excluded-high-size profile, and preserve precise sentinel diagnostics when the compatible profile is malformed.

observations.writer_profile: dwgWriter24 emits a zero high-size word for AC1027/AC1032 and sets the low HEADER size to exclude that word. The generated test input is made locally from scratch; no drawing fixture is added.
control_corrections: The AC1027 excluded-word vector is already emitted in the excluded-size form; the test no longer subtracts four from its size a second time.
The AC1027 low-maintenance vector removes the high-size word while keeping the writer's excluded byte count and recomputes the CRC at the shifted trailer.
AC1027/AC1032 compatibility-warning, suffix, CRC-refusal and sentinel cases now state the expected behavior of the selected profile.
observations.diagnostic_behavior: When the compatible high-size-excluded candidate reaches a begin/end sentinel mismatch, inspectDwgHeaderEnvelope returns that candidate's sentinel error instead of replacing it with the canonical candidate's less-specific bounds error. The malformed file remains refused. CRC-invalid candidates do not gain fallback admission.

validation.result: 1/1 passed. The selector covers AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 generated profiles, high-size maintenance gates, exact CRC/sentinel handling, suffix refusal/admission and the excluded-size compatibility diagnostic.
validation.fixture_policy: No external DWG/DXF fixtures were added; generated controls are constructed from scratch.

limitations: This validates generated envelope profiles and error classification, not producer diversity or platform behavior.
The excluded-high-size profile remains a compatibility diagnostic and does not establish whole-file DWG support.
P6 HEADER suffix and producer qualification remain open; no support claim is promoted.
